title: Gyudon (beef rice bowl) with onions
steps: Wash the rice and cook it covered with 170 ml water for 12 minutes.
Slice the beef very thinly and cut the onion into strips.
Bring the stock to the boil with the soy sauce, sugar and grated ginger and simmer the onion in it for 4 minutes until soft.
Add the beef and cook for 1–2 minutes, briefly cooking the pak choi too.
Spoon over the rice and sprinkle with spring onion.
